caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a swan ornament made from a material resembling Parian ware, displayed on a rectangular base. The swan is positioned in profile, facing right, with its long neck gracefully curved downward and its beak pointing toward the base. The wings are detailed with feather patterns and rest against the bird’s body, with one wing slightly extended. The entire ornament, including the base, is rendered in shades of beige and off-white, with subtle shading to suggest a matte, stone-like texture. The background consists of a light cream upper half and a light greenish-gray lower half, which represents the surface on which the ornament sits. At the top of the composition, there is centered text in capital letters that reads, "PARIAN SWAN ORNAMENT EARLY 19th CENTURY."
title: Swan
